traceability.evidence:
Story file exists: - docs/stories/006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION.story.md (listed via tools.list_directory on docs/stories)
Core rule implementation: - src/rules/valid-story-reference.ts - Scans all comments in Program() using context.getSourceCode().getAllComments(). - handleComment() splits commentNode.value into lines, normalizes them, and picks those starting with '@story'. - validateStoryPath() extracts the path token and delegates to processStoryPath(). - processStoryPath(): - Calls performSecurityValidations() (from src/rules/helpers/valid-story-reference-helpers.ts) to enforce REQ-SECURITY-VALIDATION (no disallowed absolute paths, no traversal outside project). - Checks extension with hasValidExtension() and reports messageId 'invalidExtension' when requireExt is true and extension is wrong (REQ-FILE-EXISTENCE, REQ-SECURITY-VALIDATION). - Calls reportExistenceProblems() to handle existence and filesystem errors. - reportExistenceProblems(): - Calls normalizeStoryPath(storyPath, cwd, storyDirs) from src/utils/storyReferenceUtils.ts to build candidates and compute existence. - Uses handleProjectBoundaryForExistence() (helpers) to ensure candidates/matchedPath remain inside project root, reporting 'invalidPath' when only out-of-project candidates remain (REQ-PROJECT-BOUNDARY, REQ-CONFIGURABLE-PATHS). - Delegates to reportExistenceStatus() which reports: - 'fileMissing' when status === 'missing'. - 'fileAccessError' when status === 'fs-error', including the formatted underlying error message in data.error (REQ-ERROR-HANDLING). - Rule meta: - messages: 'fileMissing', 'invalidExtension', 'invalidPath', 'fileAccessError' with clear wording and interpolation of {{path}} and {{error}} for diagnostics (User Experience & Error Handling A/C). - schema defines configurable options: storyDirectories (string[]), allowAbsolutePaths (boolean), requireStoryExtension (boolean) (REQ-CONFIGURABLE-PATHS). - create(context): - Determines cwd from context.cwd or process.cwd (REQ-PATH-RESOLUTION). - Applies defaults: storyDirs = opts.storyDirectories || ["docs/stories", "stories"], allowAbsolute = opts.allowAbsolutePaths || false, requireExt = opts.requireStoryExtension !== false.
Helper and utility implementations: - src/rules/helpers/valid-story-reference-helpers.ts - performSecurityValidations(): - If path.isAbsolute(storyPath) and allowAbsolute is false, reports 'invalidPath' and stops; if allowed, continues but still subject to boundary checks. - For paths containing '..' or separators, resolves full = path.resolve(cwd, path.normalize(storyPath)); if full does not start with cwd + path.sep, reports 'invalidPath' and stops. - Implements REQ-SECURITY-VALIDATION and contributes to REQ-PATH-RESOLUTION. - analyzeCandidateBoundaries() and handleProjectBoundaryForExistence(): - Use enforceProjectBoundary() from src/utils/storyReferenceUtils.ts to decide if candidates / matchedPath are inside project root. - If all candidates are outside project and none inside, call reportInvalidPath() and short-circuit; also reject exists==true matches outside project (REQ-PROJECT-BOUNDARY, REQ-CONFIGURABLE-PATHS).
- src/utils/storyReferenceUtils.ts - buildStoryCandidates(storyPath, cwd, storyDirs): - If storyPath starts with './' or '../', produces path.resolve(cwd, storyPath) only. - Otherwise, first adds path.resolve(cwd, storyPath) then for each dir in storyDirs adds path.resolve(cwd, dir, basename(storyPath)). - Implements REQ-PATH-RESOLUTION (relative from cwd + configured storyDirectories). - Caching and existence checks (REQ-FILE-EXISTENCE, REQ-PERFORMANCE-OPTIMIZATION, REQ-ERROR-HANDLING): - fileExistStatusCache: Map keyed by absolute path. - checkSingleCandidate(): - Uses fs.existsSync and fs.statSync inside try/catch. - Distinguishes 'exists' (regular file), 'missing' (no file or non-file), and 'fs-error' (any thrown error) and caches results. - getStoryExistence(candidates): - Iterates candidates, returning first 'exists'; otherwise, if any 'fs-error', returns status 'fs-error' plus error; else 'missing'. - storyExists(paths): returns getStoryExistence(paths).status === 'exists' (preserves legacy boolean API but backed by richer result). - __resetStoryExistenceCacheForTests(): clears cache for clean test runs. - Project boundary and security helpers: - enforceProjectBoundary(candidate, cwd): resolves both, then checks normalizedCandidate === normalizedCwd or startsWith(normalizedCwd + path.sep) (REQ-PROJECT-BOUNDARY). - hasValidExtension(p): returns p.endsWith('.story.md') (REQ-SECURITY-VALIDATION / extension convention). - isAbsolutePath, containsPathTraversal, isTraversalUnsafe: low-level helpers to detect unsafe paths (security).
Tests specifically for this story: - tests/rules/valid-story-reference.test.ts - JSDoc header: - @story docs/stories/006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION.story.md - @req tags for REQ-FILE-EXISTENCE, REQ-ERROR-HANDLING, and 007.0 error-reporting story requirements, confirming explicit traceability. - RuleTester suite "Valid Story Reference Rule (Story 006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION)": - Valid tests: - '[REQ-FILE-EXISTENCE] valid story file reference' with code '// @story docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md'. - '[REQ-EXTENSION] valid .story.md extension' with another .story.md file. - '[REQ-PATH-RESOLUTION] valid relative path with ./ prefix'. - Invalid tests: - '[REQ-PATH-RESOLUTION] missing file' → expects messageId 'fileMissing' with data.path 'docs/stories/missing-file.story.md'. - '[REQ-EXTENSION] invalid extension' → expects 'invalidExtension'. - '[REQ-PATH-SECURITY] path traversal' → '../outside.story.md' → 'invalidPath'. - '[REQ-ABSOLUTE-PATH] absolute path not allowed' → '/etc/passwd.story.md' → 'invalidPath'. - Separate RuleTester instances verify configuration and boundary behavior: - configurablePathsTester: options { storyDirectories: ["docs/stories"] } with bare '001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md' and an explicit story in docs/stories; no errors expected. - allowAbsolutePathsTester: tests allowAbsolutePaths true vs false for an absolute in-project path built with path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md'). Valid when true; 'invalidPath' when false. - relaxedExtensionTester: { storyDirectories: ["docs/stories"], requireStoryExtension: false } with a .story.md file plus the 006 story; asserts no 'invalidExtension'. - projectBoundaryTester: story reference to an absolute path like '/outside-project/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md' with storyDirectories pointing outside project; expects 'invalidPath'. - Jest describe blocks with runRuleOnCode helper validate more complex scenarios: - "uses storyDirectories when resolving relative paths" — mocks fs.existsSync/statSync to simulate existence inside docs/stories and ensures diagnostics collection works. - "allowAbsolutePaths permits absolute paths inside project" — ensures diagnostics array is returned with no crash when absolute in-project path is allowed. - "storyDirectories cannot escape project" and "misconfigured storyDirectories outside project cannot validate external files" — simulate external directories/files and assert at least one diagnostic with messageId 'invalidPath'. - "requireStoryExtension=false accepts existing .md story file" — uses developer-story.map.md with requireStoryExtension: false and asserts no 'invalidExtension' diagnostics (REQ-CONFIGURABLE-PATHS). - Error handling tests (directly and via rule): - For storyExists(): - Mocks fs.existsSync and fs.statSync to throw EACCES / EIO and asserts that storyExists([...]) does not throw and returns false (REQ-ERROR-HANDLING). - For rule diagnostics: - When fs.existsSync is true and fs.statSync throws EIO, runRuleOnCode for an @story path asserts diagnostics include at least one 'fileAccessError' with errorData.error matching /EIO/i. - When both fs.existsSync and fs.statSync throw EACCES, runRuleOnCode reports 'fileAccessError' and error message includes 'EACCES'.
Documentation: - docs/rules/valid-story-reference.md - Describes the rule: validates @story annotations refer to existing .story.md files; prevents invalid absolute/traversal paths. - Explicitly references this story and core requirements via @story and @req tags. - "Boundary & Configuration" section explains: - How candidates are classified as inside/outside project. - That all out-of-bounds candidates cause 'invalidPath' even if a file exists there. - Distinction between 'fileMissing', 'invalidExtension', 'invalidPath', and 'fileAccessError'. - Documents options storyDirectories, allowAbsolutePaths, and requireStoryExtension with behavior details and examples.

traceability.notes: The 'valid-story-reference' ESLint rule plus its helpers and utilities implement all requirements in docs/stories/006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION.story.md. @story annotations are parsed from comments, paths are resolved relative to cwd and configurable storyDirectories, and security checks prevent disallowed absolute paths and traversal outside the project. File existence is checked with cached, error-resilient filesystem operations that distinguish missing files from filesystem errors, reporting clear diagnostics: fileMissing, invalidExtension, invalidPath, and fileAccessError. Project-boundary enforcement ensures that even misconfigured storyDirectories or absolute paths cannot validate files outside the repository. Configuration options (storyDirectories, allowAbsolutePaths, requireStoryExtension) behave as specified and are thoroughly covered by Jest/RuleTester tests, which also validate error-handling scenarios (permissions errors, I/O errors) and confirm no uncaught exceptions. Story-specific documentation in docs/rules/valid-story-reference.md matches the implemented behavior and configuration. Targeted tests for this story passed, so all acceptance criteria for 006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION are satisfied.
